transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I’m here because this has been going on for months, and I need someone to take it seriously. I believe my husband’s family has been quietly interfering with our money and our reputation. Little things keep happening—billing errors at work, people at church acting strange toward me—and even when other people pull up records and say it doesn’t show anything, I know it all ties back to them somehow.
Can you tell me more about these suspicions you have about your husband's family? For example, do you feel they are targeting you through means that others might not believe or understand?

Yes. I mean, it’s not like I can point to one big thing and say, “There it is,” but it’s been months of these little things adding up. Billing errors show up at work that make me look careless, or someone at church will suddenly act strange toward me, like they’ve heard something. And every time someone checks a record and says nothing is there, I still know it connects back to my husband’s family. It feels like they’re doing it quietly, in ways other people won’t see.
Do you feel that certain events or actions by others have a special, hidden meaning that only you can understand, even if others might not see it that way?

Yes… I do feel like that. Like when a billing error shows up at work, it isn’t just a mistake to me. Or when someone at church acts funny all of a sudden, I feel like there’s a reason behind it. Other people say they don’t see anything in the records, but I know these things tie back to my husband’s family somehow. They’re doing it quietly, so it looks like nothing to everyone else.
Do you ever feel like certain events or actions are directly targeted at you, even if there’s no clear evidence, and do these feelings happen frequently or almost all the time?

Yes. It happens a lot, honestly. I’ll see a billing mistake at work, or someone at church will suddenly act different toward me, and it feels like it’s aimed at me. I know other people say there’s no proof when they check records, but to me it keeps pointing back to my husband’s family. It’s been going on for months, and I can’t just ignore it.
Can you describe one of these situations in detail, like the billing mistake or someone acting strange at church, and explain how you came to believe it was connected to your husband’s family?

One example is at work, with the billing. I’m a posting clerk, so I know mistakes can happen, but these little errors started showing up in ways that made me look bad, like I wasn’t doing my job right. And then when I tried to have people check the records, they’d say they didn’t see anything unusual, but that’s kind of the point. It’s being done quietly.

I came to believe it was connected to my husband’s family because it’s not just one thing. It’s been months of things like that, and then someone at church will suddenly be different with me, like they’ve heard something about me or our family. It feels like they’re trying to mess with our money and our good name without leaving anything obvious behind. Other people may not see it, but I know it ties back to them.
